crombolo types add-property

Append a property to a type, and apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo types add-property <type> <alias> --type <type> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--mandatory] [--tab <tab>] [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
typeThe type's alias. Required.
aliasThe property's alias. Required.
--typeThe data type. Required.
--nameThe property's name.
--descriptionThe property's description.
--mandatoryAn editor must fill it in.
--tabThe tab it goes in.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo types check

Validate schema/ and report what a sync would do to this database. Changes nothing.

crombolo types check [--static]
ArgumentWhat it is
--staticValidate the files only, no database.

crombolo types export

Write the database's definitions as schema/ files. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo types export

crombolo types new

Write a type or data type file, and the view it points at, then apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo types new <kind> <alias> [--name <name>] [--description <description>] [--icon <icon>] [--at-root] [--element] [--tab <tab>] [--no-view] [--compose <compose>] [--allow-child <allow-child>] [--vary-by-culture] [--vary-by-segment] [--library] [--list-view] [--list-view-type <list-view-type>] [--editor <editor>] [--max-chars <max-chars>] [--rows <rows>] [--min <min>] [--max <max>] [--step <step>] [--default-on] [--label <label>] [--with-time] [--option <option>] [--multiple] [--allow <allow>] [--block <block>] [--columns <columns>]
ArgumentWhat it is
kindWhat kind of type. One of content-type, media-type, member-type, data-type. Required.
aliasThe type's alias. Required.
--nameThe type's name.
--descriptionThe type's description.
--iconThe type's icon.
--at-rootAllow it at the root of the tree.
--elementAn element type, for blocks.
--tabThe tab its first property goes in.
--no-viewNo view: a type nothing renders.
--composeA type it is composed of.
--allow-childA type allowed beneath it.
--vary-by-cultureIts content differs by language.
--vary-by-segmentIts content differs by segment.
--libraryIt may be created in the Library.
--list-viewShow the pages beneath it as a list.
--list-view-typeThe list view data type, instead of the default.
--editorData types: the editor it uses. One of textstring, textarea, rich-text, number, toggle, date, dropdown, content-picker, media-picker, element-picker, block-list, block-grid.
--max-charsData types: the most characters allowed.
--rowsData types: the rows a text area shows.
--minData types: the least allowed (number, items).
--maxData types: the most allowed (number, items).
--stepData types: the step between numbers.
--default-onData types: a toggle starts on.
--labelData types: a toggle's label.
--with-timeData types: a date with a time of day.
--optionData types: a dropdown choice.
--multipleData types: more than one may be chosen.
--allowData types: a type a picker offers.
--blockData types: an element type offered as a block.
--columnsData types: the columns a block grid has.

crombolo types purge

Delete properties retired more than N days ago, with their values. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo types purge --older-than <older-than> [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
--older-thanHow long, in days, a property must have been retired. Required.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo types rewrite

Rewrite every schema/ file canonically. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo types rewrite

crombolo types sync

Apply schema/ to the database. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo types sync [--force-retire-types]
ArgumentWhat it is
--force-retire-typesRetire a type the files no longer have even though content uses it.

crombolo languages add

Add a language to languages.toml, then apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo languages add <iso> [--name <name>] [--default] [--mandatory] [--fallback <fallback>]
ArgumentWhat it is
isoThe language code, such as fr-FR. Required.
--nameIts name; from the code when absent.
--defaultMake it the default language.
--mandatoryA page must be filled in this language to publish.
--fallbackThe language shown when this one is empty.

crombolo languages list

The languages languages.toml declares. Changes nothing.

crombolo languages list

crombolo forms new

Write a form asking for a name and an email address, then apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo forms new <alias> [--name <name>]
ArgumentWhat it is
aliasThe form's alias. Required.
--nameThe form's name.

crombolo workflows new

Write an approval workflow with one stage, then apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo workflows new <alias> [--name <name>] [--content-type <content-type>] [--approver <approver>]
ArgumentWhat it is
aliasThe workflow's alias. Required.
--nameThe workflow's name.
--content-typeA content type it covers.
--approverA user group who approve; editors when absent.

crombolo webhooks new

Write a webhook kept with the site, checked as the server reads it. Each run acts again.

crombolo webhooks new <alias> --url <url> --event <event> [--content-type <content-type>] [--name <name>] [--header <header>]
ArgumentWhat it is
aliasThe webhook's alias. Required.
--urlWhere it is sent. Required.
--eventAn event that sends it, such as Umbraco.ContentPublish. Required.
--content-typeOnly for pages of this type.
--nameThe webhook's name.
--headerA header sent with it, as Name=env:VARIABLE.

values.value: the command line’s own description of its commands
Check, apply and change the content model kept in schema/: types, languages, forms, workflows and webhooks.
